abilities.name: Amplify Curse
abilities.desc: Increases the effect of your next Curse of Weakness or Bane of Agony by 50%, or your next Curse of Exhaustion by 20%. Lasts 30 sec.

abilities.name: Bane of Agony
abilities.desc: Afflicts the target with agony, causing 552 Shadow damage over 24 sec. This damage is dealt slowly at first, and builds up as the Bane reaches its full duration. Only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

abilities.name: Bane of Doom
abilities.desc: Afflicts the target with impending doom, causing 1,742 Shadow damage after 1 min. If the target dies from this damage, there is a chance that a Doomguard will be summoned. Cannot be cast on players. Only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

abilities.name: Corruption
abilities.desc: Corrupts the target, causing 438 Shadow damage over 18 sec.

abilities.name: Curse of Exhaustion
abilities.desc: Reduces the target's movement speed by 30% for 12 sec. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

abilities.name: Curse of Recklessness
abilities.desc: Curses the target with recklessness, reducing the target's armor by 505 for 2 min. Cursed enemies will not flee and will ignore Fear and Horror effects. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

abilities.name: Curse of the Elements
abilities.desc: Curses the target for 5 min, reducing Magic resistances by 75 and increasing Magic damage taken by 10%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

abilities.name: Curse of Tongues
abilities.desc: Forces the target to speak in Demonic, increasing the casting time of all spells by 60%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target. Lasts 30 sec.

abilities.name: Curse of Weakness
abilities.desc: Physical damage caused by the target is reduced by 37 for 2 min. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

abilities.name: Death Coil
abilities.desc: Causes the enemy target to run in horror for 3 sec and causes 460 Shadow damage. The caster gains 100% of the damage caused in health.

abilities.name: Drain Life
abilities.desc: Transfers 51 health every 1 second from the target to the caster. Lasts 5 sec.

abilities.name: Drain Mana
abilities.desc: Transfers 139 Mana every 1 sec from the target to the caster. Lasts 5 sec.

abilities.name: Drain Soul
abilities.desc: Drains the soul of the target, causing 420 Shadow damage over 15 sec. Non-trivial targets damaged by Drain Soul have a chance to grant you a Soul Shard. Non-trivial targets killed by Drain Soul will always grant you a Soul shard. Soul Shards are required for other spells.

abilities.name: Fear
abilities.desc: Strikes fear in the enemy, causing it to run in fear for up to 20 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only 1 target can be feared at a time.

abilities.name: Howl of Terror
abilities.desc: Howl, causing 5 enemies within 10 yds to flee in terror for 15 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

abilities.name: Life Tap
abilities.desc: Converts 424 Health into 424 Mana for you. Spirit increases the amount converted.

abilities.name: Siphon Life
abilities.desc: Transfers 41 health from the target to the caster every 3 sec. Lasts 30 sec.

abilities.name: Wrack
abilities.desc: Tears the target apart from within, inflicting 36 Shadow damage every 1 sec and increasing the damage they take from your other Shadow damage over time effects by 10% for 6 sec.

abilities.name: Banish
abilities.desc: Banishes the enemy target, preventing all action but making it invulnerable for up to 30 sec. Only one target can be banished at a time. Only works on Demons and Elementals.

abilities.name: Create Firestone
abilities.desc:
Creates a Major Firestone which can be used to enchant your weapon with Fire, increasing your spell critical strike chance by 2% and the damage done by your Fire spells by up to 21.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

abilities.name: Create Healthstone
abilities.desc:
Creates a Major Healthstone that can be used to instantly restore 1,440 health.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

abilities.name: Create Soulstone
abilities.desc:
Creates a Major Soulstone. The Soulstone can be used to store one target's soul. If the target dies while their soul is stored, they will be able to resurrect with 2,200 health and 2800 mana.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

abilities.name: Create Spellstone
abilities.desc:
Creates a Major Spellstone which can be used to enchant your weapon with Shadow, increasing your spell haste by 2% and the damage done by your Shadow spells by up to 21.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

abilities.name: Demon Armor
abilities.desc: Protects the caster, increasing armor by 570, Shadow resistance by 15 and increases health regeneration by 15 health per 5 sec. for 30 min.

abilities.name: Demon Skin
abilities.desc: Protects the caster, increasing armor by 120 and increases health regeneration by 5 health per 5 sec. for 30 min.

abilities.name: Demonic Sacrifice
abilities.desc:
When activated, sacrifices your summoned Demon to enhance the opposing aspect of your power, granting you an effect that lasts 2 hrs. The effect is canceled if any Demon is summoned.

Imp: Increases your Shadow damage by 15%.

Voidwalker: Restores 2% of your total Mana every 4 sec.

Succubus/Incubus: Increases your Fire damage by 15%.

Felhunter: Restores 3% of your total Health every 4 sec.

abilities.name: Detect Invisibility
abilities.desc: Allows the friendly target to detect greater invisibility for 10 min.

abilities.name: Eye of Kilrogg
abilities.desc: Summons an Eye of Kilrogg and binds your vision to it. The eye moves quickly but is very fragile.

abilities.name: Fel Domination
abilities.desc: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Summon spell has its casting time reduced by 5.5 sec and its Mana cost reduced by 50%.

abilities.name: Health Funnel
lines: 79 Health, plus 61 per sec  ·  20 yd range
abilities.desc: Gives 153 health to the caster's pet every second for 10 sec as long as the caster channels. Generates reduced threat.

abilities.name: Inferno
abilities.desc: Summons a meteor from the Twisting Nether, causing 200 Fire damage and stunning all enemy targets in the area for 2 sec. An Infernal rises from the crater, under the command of the caster for 5 min. Once control is lost, the Infernal must be Subjugated to maintain control. Can only be used outdoors.

abilities.name: Ritual of Doom
abilities.desc: Begins a ritual that sacrifices a random participant to summon a doomguard. The doomguard must be immediately subjugated or it will attack the ritual participants. Requires the caster and 4 additional party members to complete the ritual. In order to participate, all players must right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

abilities.name: Ritual of Summoning
abilities.desc: Begins a ritual that summons the targeted group member. Requires the caster and 2 additional party members to complete the ritual. In order to participate, all players must be out of combat and right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

abilities.name: Sense Demons
abilities.desc: Shows the location of all nearby demons on the minimap until cancelled. Only one type of tracking can be used at a time.

abilities.name: Shadow Ward
abilities.desc: Absorbs 920 shadow damage. Lasts 30 sec.

abilities.name: Soul Link
abilities.desc: When active, 30% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Demon instead. In addition, both the Demon and the master will inflict 3% more damage. Lasts as long as the Demon is active.

abilities.name: Subjugate Demon
abilities.desc: Subjugates the target demon, up to level 64, forcing it to do your bidding. While subjugated, the time between the demon's attacks is increased by 40% and its casting speed is slowed by 30%. Lasts up to 5 min. If you repeatedly subjugate the same demon, it will become more difficult to control with each attempt.

abilities.name: Summon Felhunter
abilities.desc: Summons a Felhunter under the command of the Warlock.

abilities.name: Summon Imp
abilities.desc: Summons an Imp under the command of the Warlock.

abilities.name: Summon Incubus
abilities.desc: Summons an Incubus under the command of the Warlock.

abilities.name: Summon Succubus
abilities.desc: Summons a Succubus under the command of the Warlock.

abilities.name: Summon Voidwalker
abilities.desc: Summons a Voidwalker under the command of the Warlock.

abilities.name: Unending Breath
abilities.desc: Allows the target to breathe underwater for 10 min.

abilities.name: Bane of Havoc
abilities.desc: Afflicts the target for 5 min, causing 15% of all damage done by the Warlock to other targets to also be dealt to the cursed target. Bane of Havoc is limited to 1 target, and only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

abilities.name: Conflagrate
abilities.desc: Ignites a target that is already afflicted by your Immolate spell, dealing 251 to 313 Fire damage and consuming your Immolate effect.

abilities.name: Hellfire
abilities.desc: Ignites the area surrounding the caster, causing 210 Fire damage to himself and 210 Fire damage to all nearby enemies every 1 sec. Lasts 15 sec.

abilities.name: Immolate
abilities.desc: Burns the enemy for 158 Fire damage and then an additional 275 Fire damage over 15 sec.

abilities.name: Incinerate
abilities.desc: Deals 201 to 233 Fire damage to your target and an additional 25% damage if the target is afflicted by Immolate.

abilities.name: Rain of Fire
abilities.desc: Calls down a fiery rain to burn enemies in the area of effect for 884 Fire damage over 8 sec.

abilities.name: Searing Pain
abilities.desc: Inflict searing pain on the enemy target, causing 107 to 125 Fire damage. Causes a high amount of threat.

abilities.name: Shadow Bolt
abilities.desc: Sends a shadowy bolt at the enemy, causing 253 to 283 Shadow damage.

abilities.name: Shadowburn
abilities.desc: Instantly blasts the target for 258 to 288 Shadow damage. If the target dies within 8 sec of Shadowburn, and yields experience or honor, the caster gains a Soul Shard.

abilities.name: Soul Fire
abilities.desc: Burn the enemy's soul, causing 390 to 486 Fire damage.

abilities.name: Shoot
abilities.desc: Attack with an equipped wand.

abilities.name: Blood Fury
abilities.desc: Increases Attack Power and Spell Power by 10% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Shatter Curse
abilities.desc: Instantly removes all Curses and Banes, and reduces all Magical damage taken by 5% for 8 sec.

abilities.name: Will of the Forsaken
abilities.desc: Instantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects.

abilities.name: Cannibalize
abilities.desc: When activated, regenerates 7% of total Health and 7% of total Mana every 2 sec for 10 sec. Only works on Humanoid or Undead corpses within 5 yds. Any movement, action, or damage taken while Cannibalizing will cancel the effect.

abilities.name: Berserking
abilities.desc: Increases your spellcasting and attack speed by 10% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Rapid Regeneration
abilities.desc: Regenerate 50% of your maximum Health over 6 sec. Any movement, action, or damage taken will cancel the effect.

abilities.name: Perception
abilities.desc: Dramatically increases stealth detection for 20 sec.

abilities.name: Will to Survive
abilities.desc: Instantly removes all Stun effects.

abilities.name: Escape Artist
abilities.desc: Instantly escape the effects of any movement impairing effect and gain immunity to those effects for 3 sec.

abilities.name: Eureka!
abilities.desc: For 8 sec, your non-periodic damaging abilities cost 10% less (Mana, Rage or Energy) and deal 10% more damage. For Priests, your non-periodic damaging or healing abilities cost 10% less Mana and do 10% more damage or healing. Periodic effects get nothing from it; a channeled spell is not periodic. The Mage's own tooltip is the one that leaves out non-periodic.
